lines.name: Ben
lines.en: Good morning! Next, please. How can I help you?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like to send a birthday gift to my older brother in London.
lines.ko: 런던에 사는 오빠에게 생일 선물을 보내고 싶어요.

lines.name: Ben
lines.en: London. Sure! Please put it on the scale. What's inside the box?
lines.ko: 런던이요. 네! 저울 위에 올려 주세요. 상자 안에 뭐가 들었어요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: It's a book and some Korean snacks.

lines.name: Ben
lines.en: A book and snacks. OK. Are there any liquids or meat in the snacks?
lines.ko: 책이랑 과자요. 네. 과자에 액체나 고기가 들어 있나요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No, there aren't. They're made of chestnuts.

lines.name: Ben
lines.en: Chestnut snacks! That's fine, then. How would you like to send it? By air or by sea?
lines.ko: 밤 과자군요! 그럼 괜찮아요. 어떻게 보내시겠어요? 항공으로요, 배로요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'll send it by air because my older brother's birthday is coming soon.

lines.name: Ben
lines.en: By air, it takes about five to seven days. Could you fill out this customs form, please?
lines.ko: 항공으로는 5일에서 7일 정도 걸려요. 이 세관 신고서 좀 작성해 주시겠어요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I'll fill out the form. Here it is.

lines.name: Ben
lines.en: Thank you. That's thirty-two thousand won. Would you like to add insurance for the package?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No, thanks. Just send it without insurance.
lines.ko: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 보험 없이 그냥 보내 주세요.

lines.name: Ben
lines.en: OK, no insurance. Here's your receipt with the tracking number. Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.ko: 네, 보험 없이요. 송장 번호가 적힌 영수증 여기 있어요. 더 도와드릴 게 있을까요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: When will it arrive in London?

lines.name: Ben
lines.en: It should arrive in London by next Monday. You can check it online with the tracking number. Have a nice day!
lines.ko: 다음 주 월요일까지는 런던에 도착할 거예요. 송장 번호로 온라인에서 확인하실 수 있어요. 좋은 하루 보내세요!

vocab.example: I'd like to send a birthday gift to my older brother.
My older brother's birthday is coming soon.
Could you fill out this customs form, please?
Yes, I'll fill out the form. Here it is.
Here's your receipt with the tracking number.
